tools.name: listseat_claim_status
tools.description: Unpaid lookup. Checks whether an origin has a ping-verified row on GET /verified. Returns claimed and listed only from that row. listed=true is never invented. Does not pay. Seat door is GET /api/v1/listseat at $0.09.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_seat" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
